title: 第7章 你辱我退亲必须退亲第8章 人设不能崩太快
slug: 乱世荒年我每日一卦粮肉满仓
content_zh:
第7章你辱我！
退亲，必须退亲！
沃日……江尘不禁为原主感到悲哀，快把家里掏空了，连一起散步都是施舍吗？恐怕手指都没碰到一下吧。
不过面上，却还是做出了猪哥的模样。
好戏，才开始呢。
江有林已经气的用拐杖砸地：“江田，赶紧把你弟弟带进去！”
江田起身，拉着江尘的手：“走，爹房间内生了火，去暖和暖和。”
“等等。”
孙金梅眼带笑意，抬手阻止：“我觉得小尘说得对，三十两还是少了，就应该六十两！”
江有林脸有些发僵，扯动嘴角：“亲家母，你就别开玩笑了，六十两银子我到哪儿去弄啊？”
“那我不管，反正你儿子想娶我女儿，就得这么多钱。”
“你好好想想，除了我家花儿，还有谁愿意嫁你这不成器的儿子？”
江有林擦了擦额头的细汗，身体微微前倾，带着讨好：“要不，五十两？”
明年上二黑山，要是打两头野猪，再加上两张兽皮……卖三亩田，大概是够的，总不能真的让儿子娶不上媳妇儿。
孙金梅扫了一眼堂屋，好像真的没别的油水了。
终于点了点头：“看在乡里乡亲的份上，那就五十两，而且我女儿只等一年！”
“一年要是凑不够聘礼，就嫁给别人了。”
“好……好，一年。”
江有林苦涩的应了一声。
“五十两……疯了……真疯了”

陈巧翠已经忘了争辩，不断讷讷重复，仿佛见鬼一样。
江尘也喜笑颜开：“对啊，起码也得五十两，否则就对不起花儿。”
“还有这只兔子，分的也麻烦，婶子你全带回去吃。”
孙金梅心中又是一喜，这江尘看来知道自己做了错事，知道刻意讨好自己了。
就江尘对女儿的态度，以后还不是想怎么拿捏就怎么拿捏?
心中想着怎么扣出更多好处，面上却是不假辞色。
昂着头对江尘开口：“算你懂事。”
“但你记住了，就算是给了五十两的聘礼，花儿嫁给你这泼皮也是你占了便宜。”
“村里除了我家花儿，谁还愿意嫁给你啊。”
说着，顺手接过那只雪兔，稍稍发力，却发现怎么也扯不动。
抬头，才看到刚刚还一脸和善的江尘眼眸上抬，忽然露出了想要杀人的眼神。
content_en:
Chapter 7 You insult me!
To cancel the engagement, we must cancel the engagement!
Wo Ri...Jiang Chen couldn't help but feel sad for the original owner, who had almost emptied the house. Is even taking a walk together a charity? I'm afraid I haven't even touched it with my fingers.
But on the surface, he still looked like Brother Pig.
The fun has just begun.
Jiang Youlin was so angry that he hit the ground with his crutch: "Jiang Tian, bring your brother in quickly!"
Jiang Tian stood up and took Jiang Chen's hand: "Come on, dad has lit a fire in the room, go and warm yourself up."
"Wait."
With a smile in her eyes, Sun Jinmei raised her hand to stop: "I think Xiao Chen is right, thirty taels is still too little, it should be sixty taels!"
Jiang Youlin's face stiffened and he twitched the corners of his mouth: "My mother-in-law, stop joking. Where can I get sixty taels of silver?"
"Then I don't care. Anyway, if your son wants to marry my daughter, he will need so much money."
"Think about it carefully, besides my Hua'er, who else is willing to marry your worthless son?"
Jiang Youlin wiped the sweat from his forehead, leaned forward slightly, and said with a flattering tone, "How about fifty taels?"
Next year when I go to Erheishan, I can hunt two wild boars, plus two animal skins... and sell three acres of land, which will probably be enough, but I can't really prevent my son from getting a wife.
Sun Jinmei glanced at the main room, and it seemed that there was really nothing else to do.
Finally nodded: "For the sake of the folks in my hometown, that's fifty taels, and my daughter will only wait for one year!"
"If you can't raise enough dowry in one year, you'll marry someone else."
"Okay... okay, one year."
Jiang Youlin responded bitterly.
"Fifty taels... crazy... really crazy."
Chen Qiaocui had forgotten to argue and kept repeating it as if she had seen a ghost.
Jiang Chen also beamed: "Yes, at least fifty taels, otherwise I will be sorry for Hua'er."
"There's also this rabbit. It's troublesome to divide it. Auntie, take it all back and eat it."
Sun Jinmei felt happy again. Jiang Chen seemed to know that he had done something wrong and was deliberately trying to please himself.
As for Jiang Chen's attitude towards his daughter, will he be able to manipulate it however he wants in the future?
He was thinking about how to extract more benefits, but his words were not false.
He held his head high and said to Jiang Chen, "I guess you are sensible."
"But remember, even if I was given a bride price of fifty taels, you took advantage of Hua'er marrying a naughty guy like you."
"Other than my Hua'er, who else in the village is willing to marry you."
As he said that, he took the snow rabbit and tried a little harder, but found that he couldn't pull it away.
When he raised his head, he saw that Jiang Chen, who had a kind face just now, raised his eyes, and suddenly showed a look that wanted to kill someone.
